Our studio lighting rig renders skin tones evenly no matter how formal or long the guest list, so the hundredth portrait of the night looks as considered as the first.

These same venues are also the ones most likely to ask for vendor paperwork before they'll confirm us, and it's a step we treat as routine rather than an inconvenience. We carry a $3 million policy and turn a certificate of insurance around the same day you give us the venue's contact, which matches what most Westchester country clubs and historic estates require before load-in.

Setup wants 10ft x 10ft for the backdrop and prop table, compressing to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of clearance for a tighter room, plus a standard 110V outlet within 15 feet, which we run ourselves. Travel to White Plains, Yonkers, New Rochelle, Rye, Scarsdale and Tarrytown is quoted from your venue's ZIP code before you book, so there's nothing to discover on the invoice afterward.

faqHeading: Glam Photo Booth in Westchester — FAQ

faqs.q: Can you provide a certificate of insurance for a Westchester country club?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million insurance policy and turn COIs around the same day you send us the venue's contact — this is close to routine given how often Westchester's country clubs and historic estates require it before load-in.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee to bring the glam booth to Westchester?
faqs.a: There's no flat rate the way there is closer to Brooklyn. Travel to White Plains, Yonkers, New Rochelle, Rye and the surrounding areas is quoted from your venue's exact ZIP code before you book.

faqs.q: Can the glam booth keep up with a large country club wedding or gala?
faqs.a: Yes — unlimited sessions and unlimited prints mean guest count isn't a limit. For very large events we often suggest pairing the glam booth with a roaming attendant or a second station so the line stays short through cocktail hour.

faqs.q: Does the glam booth's black-and-white look fit a historic estate setting?
faqs.a: It tends to fit especially well — the editorial black-and-white style reads as intentional rather than casual, which suits the formal character of Westchester's historic estates and country clubs better than a brightly colored, prop-heavy setup would.

faqs.q: How much space does the glam booth need at a Westchester venue?
faqs.a: 10ft x 10ft is optimal for the backdrop, prop table and a red-carpet feel; we can compress to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance for tighter rooms.

faqs.q: Is color available, or is it black-and-white only?
faqs.a: Both — the black-and-white glam edit is the signature look, but the booth can output color, black-and-white, or let each guest choose.

faqs.q: What power do you need at a Westchester venue?
faqs.a: A standard 110V, 5-amp, 3-prong outlet within 15 feet of the booth. We bring our own dedicated power run rather than sharing a circuit with the DJ or catering equipment.
